description_expanded: This recently renovated beachfront family compound includes six bedrooms, six luxury baths, three half-bath powder rooms, and ample accommodations for 21 beachgoers. Guest quarters are located on all three levels, including access to an attached carriage house, providing wonderful privacy for families and friends sharing a beach reunion. It is aptly located right on the gulf within the privileged, exclusively gated community of Waters' Edge in Seacrest Beach . Seabourn features a charming Dutch Colonial-styled exterior design with balconies and columned verandas off many bedrooms and the open living area. The heavenly beachfront locale provides stunning views of the jeweled gulf from almost every room. Comfortable furnishings include cottage, coastal, and rustic beach-inspired designs. Decorative art throughout boasts seascape paintings, watercolor landscapes, and marine life sculptures. The first floor is complete with four spacious bedrooms, one of which doubles as a fun game room with two queen/full-sized bunks, a pool table, multiple sitting areas, and a flatscreen TV for entertainment. A half-bath powder room is stationed nearby for added convenience. The additional three bedrooms each feature en suite bathrooms with two king-sized beds and a cozy queen-sized bed that houses a twin bunk for the little ones. Venture upstairs to the spacious living, dining, and kitchen area on the second floor with three walls of windows showcasing panoramic gulf-front vistas. Tall white beamed ceilings, shiplap walls, and natural light provide a warm, inviting setting. Two cream-colored couches and armchairs draped with slipcovers provide a comfortable seating ensemble with gulf views. A wall-hung flatscreen TV above a beach-inspired side table provides additional entertainment. Inside the dining room, a long hardwood table with 12 colonial spindle-backed chairs sits near the open kitchen and beachside balcony doors. The open kitchen includes a raised malt-toned granite bar with five white vintage modern stools for fun wining and dining. A nearby half-bath serves as a convenient powder room. This level is attached to a guest house with another full kitchen and living area. The living room includes a white sofa and tropical accent chair that faces a wall-mounted flatscreen TV near a window balcony. A sunny dining nook beside the kitchen has a round, colorful mosaic-topped table with four chairs, while the kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The lovely guest bedroom has a queen-sized bed with a twin trundle and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. A half-bath powder room is also available off the kitchen. The primary bedroom suite encompasses the entire top floor with light beach-washed hardwood furnishings, a king-size bed facing a wall-mounted TV, an open viewing deck, a glass-topped corner table for two, and a kitchenette for preparing bedside snacks, drinks, or morning coffee. Two individual private baths have rich granite-topped vanity cabinets and walk-in showers with a window for natural light. This 30A home's beautiful beachfront location also includes a refreshing 6x16 private pool to wash away the salt after luxuriating in the glittering gulf. A gas grill is provided nearby for fun family cookouts. Only two houses down, a private neighborhood boardwalk is less than a one-minute walk away, leading to the bright, shimmering shoreline. Seabourn offers an incredible Seacrest Beach locale, while remaining close to wonderful restaurants, beach bars, and exciting shopping adventures. The idyllic coastal village of Rosemary Beach is nearby, with dining establishments, bistro bars, boutiques, galleries, and specialty shops. It also hosts fun lawn events, festivals, and seasonal firework celebrations throughout the year.  Main House: First Floor: King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Patio Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Patio Access, Queen Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Shared Tub/Shower Combo, Game Room with Two Queen/Full Bunks, Powder Room. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room, Access to Carriage House. Third Floor:  Landing with Rooftop Balcony Access, King Primary Bedroom with Two Walk-In Showers and Kitchenette + Balcony Access, Laundry. Guest House: Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom with Twin Trundle and Walk-In Shower, Powder Room, Laundry, Exterior Stairs. *Add $80.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
